comment: Copy to config.json and set only the overrides you want — every key has a built-in default (full reference in the README config table). `make setup` fills githubLogin + allowRepos for you. Bedrock auth uses KeySmith — set KEYSMITH_* in .env (see .env.example). dryRun=true performs NO GitHub writes or pushes; flip to false only when ready for live action. allowRepos non-empty scopes the pipeline to just those repos (blank = all authored PRs). autoPushClasses lists author classes ("ci"/"bot"/"human") allowed to push without owner approval when the gate passes; default [] parks every change at awaiting_approval for you to Approve (risk:high always parks regardless). Auto-fix commits are authored as githubLogin (no git user.name/user.email needed).
